items.difficulty_reason: Goodness on one side controls the derived tensor on the other: given a good resolution P -> M of a right module and N good as a left module, the author must show P tensor N -> M tensor N is a quasi-isomorphism, observes the cone C of P -> M is acyclic, that C tensor N is acyclic by goodness of N, and that C tensor N is precisely the cone of the map of tensors as a complex of O-modules. Retained author proof at lines 4988-5003.
